text:
Mira (CS): @Jordan quick sync — Ventana asked for two regional changes for their APAC pilot: 1) allowlist two CIDR blocks for peering, 2) temporary QPS increase for 7 days. Can infra review?
Sam (Eng-Infra): Thanks — can you paste the IPs and exact dates? Also need to know if this is a full region pin or just edge peering.
Jordan (Ventana): Pilot runs 2026-03-30 -> 2026-04-06. IPs: 203.0.113.0/27 and 198.51.100.128/26. Traffic shape: steady 250 qps, spikes ~380 qps for short bursts. We want a soft bump to 400 qps during the pilot.
Mira (CS): Noted. Customer wants minimal friction; renewal conversation next month so we want smooth pilot and capture any issues. Can we do auto-revoke after 7 days? Also request dashboard access for their SRE.
Leo (Network): Peering exists to their ASN but these specific CIDRs aren’t on the allowlist yet. Auto-revoke OK — we can tag entries with ttl=7d and scheduled cleanup. Need to pin traffic to ap-southeast-1 edge pool (apac-2) to guarantee latency.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Proposed config patch below — will only apply to Ventana account and edge pool apac-2:
```json
{
  "account": "ventana",
  "region_pin": "ap-southeast-1",
  "edge_pool": "apac-2",
  "allowlist": ["203.0.113.0/27","198.51.100.128/26"],
  "rate_limit": { "qps": 400, "window_s": 60, "type": "soft" },
  "meta": { "reason": "pilot 2026-03-30..2026-04-06", "auto_revoke_days": 7 }
}
```
Sam (Eng-Infra): Implementation notes: we apply an account-scoped ACL, create ephemeral tag ventana-pilot-0326, and add a rollout flag to the routing policy so requests prefer apac-2. Billing: set soft_quota to avoid hard throttle but flag for cost ops.
Mira (CS): I'll open ticket CS-8721 to track enablement, renewal note, and feedback capture. Jordan — we'll run a 30m enablement call on 2026-03-29 to walk through dashboards and runbooks.
infra-bot: provisioning job queued — job_id=job-88421, queued_by=Sam, expected start=2026-03-29T22:00:00Z.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Quick CLI to commit ACL (ops only):
```bash
redwood infra acl add --account ventana --cidr 203.0.113.0/27 --tag ventana-pilot-0326 --ttl 7d
redwood infra acl add --account ventana --cidr 198.51.100.128/26 --tag ventana-pilot-0326 --ttl 7d
redwood infra routing set --account ventana --edge-pool apac-2 --policy prefer
redwood infra rate update --account ventana --qps 400 --window 60 --type soft
```
Leo (Network): Confirmed peering ASN and route advertisement are fine. One ask: we need to add a fallback route to apac-1 if apac-2 capacity dips below 70% to avoid errors. Sam can you add that as policy?
Sam (Eng-Infra): Yep — will add capacity-based fallback to apac-1 with graceful reroute and a 10s KV cache warmup to reduce cold-start latencies. Will post rollback plan if any issue — changes will be applied 2026-03-29 22:00Z and monitored.
Jordan (Ventana): Awesome, thanks everyone. Dashboard access would be huge — can you grant read-only to ops@ventana.io?
Mira (CS): On it — I'll request dashboard invite and include sample eval prompts so we can watch quality/regression. Also logging tag "ventana-pilot-0326" will help capture errors.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Billing note: set a soft quota alert at 70% of expected pilot consumption; invoice impact should be minimal but cost ops will be notified.
Mira (CS): Follow-ups: 1) enablement call 2026-03-29 16:00 PT, 2) CS-8721 tracking tickets (setup, dashboard invite, renewal note), 3) Sam to post rollout + rollback summary in thread.
Sam (Eng-Infra): Will post postmortem-style summary after 48h of pilot completion with token & latency deltas.
Jordan (Ventana): Thanks — :thumbsup:
Leo (Network): noted
Mira (CS): Great — closing the loop here. If anything spikes unexpectedly ping #eng-oncall and tag me.
